    Forecast Accuracy

    How our precipitation forecasts compare with SNOTEL gauges near the mountains · re-scored and re-tuned every run

    Snow

    On 10 snowy station-days we forecast 11.2" vs 16.0" of measured snow-depth gain (typical miss 1.1" per day). Depth gain undercounts real snowfall because fresh snow settles, so a modest positive bias here is expected.

    The dashboard shows the NWS forecast, adjusted to each spot's elevation; our model blend runs alongside as a challenger and fills any hours the NWS doesn't cover. Bias: + means too much forecast. Wet day = at least 0.1" measured. SNOTEL gauges can under-catch wind-blown snow by 10–30%, so the scale factor is clamped to ×0.7–1.3. Sources: NRCS SNOTEL, Open-Meteo previous-runs archive.
